RFC1155-SMI.role: SMIv1 macro definitions (legacy MIB compiler input).

IEEE8021-TC-MIB.role: IEEE 802.1 textual conventions (port lists, priority, etc.).

CISCO-PRODUCTS-MIB.role: Per-platform `sysObjectID` registrations (one OID per Cisco product).

CISCO-ENTITY-VENDORTYPE-OID-MIB.role: OIDs identifying every FRU type (line cards, transceivers, fans).

SNMP-FRAMEWORK-MIB.role: RFC3411 — engine ID, security model, message processing model.

NOTIFICATION-LOG-MIB.role: RFC3014 — local log of generated notifications/traps.

DISMAN-EVENT-MIB.role: RFC2981 — distributed event/alarm trigger objects (mteTrigger, mteEvent).

DISMAN-EXPRESSION-MIB.role: RFC2982 — derive new MIB objects via formulas over existing ones.

RFC1213-MIB.role: The original "MIB-II" — `system`, `interfaces`, `at`, `ip`, `icmp`, `tcp`, `udp`, `egp`, `snmp` groups. Most leaves are now sourced from successor MIBs.

CISCO-PROCESS-MIB.role: Per-process CPU and memory utilization (`cpmCPUTotal*`, `cpmProcessExtTable`). Critical for CPU monitoring.

CISCO-ENHANCED-MEMPOOL-MIB.role: Enhanced multi-pool memory utilization (Processor, IO, Reserve, Lsmpi). Replaces the older `CISCO-MEMORY-POOL-MIB`.

CISCO-FLASH-MIB.role: Flash device inventory and free/used bytes per partition.

CISCO-IMAGE-MIB.role: IOS image string and feature tags.

IF-MIB.role: RFC2863 — `ifTable`/`ifXTable` (admin/oper status, counters, hi-counters, ifAlias, ifName). The single most-polled MIB.

EtherLike-MIB.role: RFC3635 — Ethernet-like statistics (CRC, FCS, late collisions, alignment errors).

CISCO-IF-EXTENSION-MIB.role: Cisco-specific `ifTable` extensions: input/output rates, CRC, throttles, resets, queue stats.

BRIDGE-MIB.role: RFC4188 — base 802.1D bridge group: STP state, FDB (mac address table), port table.

Q-BRIDGE-MIB.role: RFC4363 — VLAN-aware bridge: VLAN static/dynamic FDB, VLAN-membership ports, GVRP.

CISCO-VTP-MIB.role: VLAN Trunking Protocol — VTP domain, mode, revision, VLAN database.

CISCO-VLAN-IFTABLE-RELATIONSHIP-MIB.role: Maps VLAN ifIndex ↔ physical port ifIndex.

CISCO-STP-EXTENSIONS-MIB.role: UplinkFast, BackboneFast, BPDU guard/filter, root guard, loop guard, PortFast.

CISCO-ETHER-CFM-MIB.role: 802.1ag Connectivity Fault Management (MEPs, MAs, CCM stats, loopback/linktrace).

LLDP-MIB.role: IEEE 802.1AB — Link Layer Discovery Protocol local/remote tables (chassis ID, port ID, neighbor capabilities).

CISCO-CDP-MIB.role: Cisco Discovery Protocol — `cdpCacheTable` (neighbor device, platform, capabilities, native VLAN, version).

IP-MIB.role: RFC4293 — IPv4 & IPv6 unified counters, address tables, netToMedia (ARP/ND).

TCP-MIB.role: RFC4022 — TCP connection table & per-protocol counters.

UDP-MIB.role: RFC4113 — UDP listener table & datagram counters.

TUNNEL-MIB.role: RFC4087 — generic IP tunnel (GRE, IP-in-IP, 6to4) endpoint table.

NHRP-MIB.role: RFC2677 — Next Hop Resolution Protocol (used by DMVPN).

OSPF-MIB.role: RFC4750 — OSPFv2 area, neighbor, LSA, virtual-link tables.

CISCO-OSPF-MIB.role: Cisco OSPFv2 extensions (NSSA, sham-link, SPF stats).

BGP4-MIB.role: RFC4273 — BGPv4 peer table, received-prefixes, basic counters.

CISCO-BGP4-MIB.role: Cisco BGP4 extensions: per-AF peer state, capabilities, route-refresh, GR.

CISCO-EIGRP-MIB.role: EIGRP topology, neighbors, traffic stats per AS.

CISCO-IETF-ISIS-MIB.role: IS-IS LSDB, adjacencies (Cisco implementation of draft-ietf-isis-wg-mib).

CISCO-IETF-FRR-MIB.role: MPLS-TE / IP Fast Reroute backup-tunnel state.

CISCO-IETF-BFD-MIB.role: RFC7331 — BFD session table, discriminators, state.

IGMP-STD-MIB.role: RFC2933 — IGMP cache, interface table, joins.

CISCO-PIM-MIB.role: Cisco PIM extensions (BSR, Auto-RP, register stats).

DRAFT-MSDP-MIB.role: MSDP peers, SA cache (for inter-domain multicast).

MPLS-LSR-STD-MIB.role: RFC3813 — generic MPLS LSR: in/out segments, XC table, label stack.

MPLS-LDP-STD-MIB.role: RFC3815 — LDP entity, peer, session, advertisement tables.

MPLS-TE-STD-MIB.role: RFC3812 — MPLS-TE tunnel head-end tables, ERO/RRO.

MPLS-L3VPN-STD-MIB.role: RFC4382 — L3VPN VRFs, RTs, per-VRF route counters.

MPLS-VPN-MIB.role: Pre-standard L3VPN MIB (still queried by older NMS).

CISCO-IETF-MPLS-TE-EXT-STD-03-MIB.role: MPLS-TE extensions per draft-03 (SRLG, FRR detail).

DIFFSERV-MIB.role: RFC3289 — DiffServ classifiers, meters, queues, schedulers.

CISCO-NBAR-PROTOCOL-DISCOVERY-MIB.role: NBAR per-protocol byte/packet counters per interface.

CISCO-IPSEC-MIB.role: IPsec global stats, IKE/Phase-1 SA table.

CISCO-IPSEC-FLOW-MONITOR-MIB.role: Per-tunnel IPsec SA counters (legacy IPsec MIB).

CISCO-UNIFIED-FIREWALL-MIB.role: ZBFW / inspection engine policy and counter tables.

CISCO-HSRP-MIB.role: HSRP groups, virtual IP/MAC, state, priority.

CISCO-HSRP-EXT-MIB.role: HSRP tracking, secondary virtual IPs, IPv6 HSRP.

CISCO-RF-MIB.role: Redundancy Framework — active/standby supervisor state, switchover history.

ENTITY-MIB.role: RFC6933 — physical entity tree (chassis → modules → ports), entity-aliasing.

ENTITY-SENSOR-MIB.role: RFC3433 — generic sensor table (temperature, voltage, current, dBm).

CISCO-ENTITY-FRU-CONTROL-MIB.role: Power, reset, OIR control of FRUs (modules, fans, PSUs).

CISCO-ENTITY-ALARM-MIB.role: Alarm severity, source, description per entity.

CISCO-ENTITY-QFP-MIB.role: Quantum Flow Processor utilization, throughput, drops.

CISCO-ENVMON-MIB.role: Legacy environmental monitor (temperature, voltage, fan, supply state).

POWER-ETHERNET-MIB.role: RFC3621 — PSE port table, power/class/priority, MainPse table.

CISCO-POWER-ETHERNET-EXT-MIB.role: Cisco PoE+ / UPOE extensions (per-port watts, policing, perpetual-PoE).

CISCO-STACKWISE-MIB.role: StackWise / StackWise-Virtual member table, role, port speed, switchover events.

CISCO-RTTMON-MIB.role: RTTMON / IP SLA — operation table, history, statistics, reactions, latest-RTT. The main **IP SLA** instrumentation MIB.

CISCO-IPSLA-ECHO-MIB.role: IP SLA echo (UDP echo, ICMP echo).

CISCO-UBE-MIB.role: Unified Border Element call counters and resource state.

CISCO-DIAL-CONTROL-MIB.role: Cisco dial-control extensions (call history, modem stats).
